## 1. Libraries

```{r libraries}
library(tidyverse)
library(ppcor)
library(parallel)
library(patchwork)
```

## 2. Load Step 2 Data

```{r load-data}
results_dir <- here::here("results")
load(file.path(results_dir, "de_results.RData"))

# mclapply forks processes, which Windows does not support: run serially there
n_cores <- if (.Platform$OS.type == "windows") 1 else max(1, parallel::detectCores() - 1)

cat("=== Tumor ===\n")
cat("DE mRNAs:", nrow(de_mrna_expr_tumor), "x", ncol(de_mrna_expr_tumor), "samples\n")
cat("DE lncRNAs:", nrow(de_lncrna_expr_tumor), "x", ncol(de_lncrna_expr_tumor), "samples\n")
cat("DE miRNAs:", nrow(de_mirna_expr_tumor), "x", ncol(de_mirna_expr_tumor), "samples\n")

cat("\n=== Normal ===\n")
cat("DE mRNAs:", nrow(de_mrna_expr_normal), "x", ncol(de_mrna_expr_normal), "samples\n")
cat("DE lncRNAs:", nrow(de_lncrna_expr_normal), "x", ncol(de_lncrna_expr_normal), "samples\n")
cat("DE miRNAs:", nrow(de_mirna_expr_normal), "x", ncol(de_mirna_expr_normal), "samples\n")
```

## 3. Identify Candidate ceRNA Pairs

Compute Pearson correlation between every DE lncRNA and every DE mRNA.

### 3a. Tumor: lncRNA-mRNA Correlation

```{r cor-tumor, cache=TRUE}
mrna_t   <- t(de_mrna_expr_tumor)
lncrna_t <- t(de_lncrna_expr_tumor)

cor_matrix_tumor <- cor(lncrna_t, mrna_t, method = "pearson", use = "pairwise.complete.obs")
all_cors_tumor <- as.vector(cor_matrix_tumor)
all_cors_tumor <- all_cors_tumor[!is.na(all_cors_tumor)]

threshold_tumor <- round(quantile(all_cors_tumor, 0.99), 2)

cat("Tumor correlation distribution:\n")
cat("  Min:", round(min(all_cors_tumor), 3), "\n")
cat("  Median:", round(median(all_cors_tumor), 3), "\n")
cat("  Max:", round(max(all_cors_tumor), 3), "\n")
cat("  99th percentile threshold:", threshold_tumor, "\n")
```

```{r candidate-pairs-tumor}
candidate_idx_tumor <- which(cor_matrix_tumor > threshold_tumor, arr.ind = TRUE)

candidate_pairs_tumor <- data.frame(
  lncRNA = rownames(cor_matrix_tumor)[candidate_idx_tumor[, 1]],
  mRNA   = colnames(cor_matrix_tumor)[candidate_idx_tumor[, 2]],
  r      = cor_matrix_tumor[candidate_idx_tumor],
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
) %>%
  arrange(desc(r))

cat("Candidate cognate pairs (r >", threshold_tumor, "):",
    nrow(candidate_pairs_tumor), "\n")
cat("Unique lncRNAs:", n_distinct(candidate_pairs_tumor$lncRNA), "\n")
cat("Unique mRNAs:", n_distinct(candidate_pairs_tumor$mRNA), "\n")
```

### 3b. Normal: lncRNA-mRNA Correlation

```{r cor-normal, cache=TRUE}
mrna_n   <- t(de_mrna_expr_normal)
lncrna_n <- t(de_lncrna_expr_normal)

cor_matrix_normal <- cor(lncrna_n, mrna_n, method = "pearson", use = "pairwise.complete.obs")
all_cors_normal <- as.vector(cor_matrix_normal)
all_cors_normal <- all_cors_normal[!is.na(all_cors_normal)]

threshold_normal <- round(quantile(all_cors_normal, 0.99), 2)

cat("Normal correlation distribution:\n")
cat("  Min:", round(min(all_cors_normal), 3), "\n")
cat("  Median:", round(median(all_cors_normal), 3), "\n")
cat("  Max:", round(max(all_cors_normal), 3), "\n")
cat("  99th percentile threshold:", threshold_normal, "\n")
```

```{r candidate-pairs-normal}
candidate_idx_normal <- which(cor_matrix_normal > threshold_normal, arr.ind = TRUE)

if (nrow(candidate_idx_normal) > 0) {
  candidate_pairs_normal <- data.frame(
    lncRNA = rownames(cor_matrix_normal)[candidate_idx_normal[, 1]],
    mRNA   = colnames(cor_matrix_normal)[candidate_idx_normal[, 2]],
    r      = cor_matrix_normal[candidate_idx_normal],
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  ) %>%
    arrange(desc(r))

  cat("Candidate cognate pairs (r >", threshold_normal, "):",
      nrow(candidate_pairs_normal), "\n")
  cat("Unique lncRNAs:", n_distinct(candidate_pairs_normal$lncRNA), "\n")
  cat("Unique mRNAs:", n_distinct(candidate_pairs_normal$mRNA), "\n")
} else {
  candidate_pairs_normal <- data.frame()
  cat("No candidate pairs in normal at 99th percentile threshold.\n")
}
```

### 3c. Correlation Distribution Plots

```{r cor-distributions, fig.width=12, fig.height=5}
p_tumor <- ggplot(data.frame(r = all_cors_tumor), aes(x = r)) +
  geom_density(fill = "#E41A1C", alpha = 0.3) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = threshold_tumor, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  annotate("text", x = threshold_tumor + 0.03, y = 0.5,
           label = paste0("99th = ", threshold_tumor), hjust = 0, size = 3.5) +
  labs(title = "Tumor: lncRNA-mRNA Correlation Distribution",
       x = "Pearson r", y = "Density") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12)

p_normal <- ggplot(data.frame(r = all_cors_normal), aes(x = r)) +
  geom_density(fill = "#377EB8", alpha = 0.3) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = threshold_normal, linetype = "dashed", color = "blue") +
  annotate("text", x = threshold_normal + 0.03, y = 0.5,
           label = paste0("99th = ", threshold_normal), hjust = 0, size = 3.5) +
  labs(title = "Normal: lncRNA-mRNA Correlation Distribution",
       x = "Pearson r", y = "Density") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12)

p_tumor + p_normal + plot_annotation(tag_levels = "A")
```

## 4. Pre-flight Diagnostics

```{r preflight-diagnostics}
mirna_t <- t(de_mirna_expr_tumor)

common_samples <- Reduce(intersect, list(
  rownames(mrna_t), rownames(lncrna_t), rownames(mirna_t)
))

cat("=== Tumor ===\n")
cat("Common samples:", length(common_samples), "\n")

mrna_t_   <- mrna_t[common_samples, ]
lncrna_t_ <- lncrna_t[common_samples, ]
mirna_t_  <- mirna_t[common_samples, ]

cat("Candidate pairs:", nrow(candidate_pairs_tumor), "\n")
cat("DE miRNAs:", ncol(mirna_t_), "\n")
cat("Total triplets:", format(nrow(candidate_pairs_tumor) * ncol(mirna_t_), big.mark = ","), "\n")
print(summary(candidate_pairs_tumor$r))

mirna_n <- t(de_mirna_expr_normal)

common_samples_n <- Reduce(intersect, list(
  rownames(mrna_n), rownames(lncrna_n), rownames(mirna_n)
))

cat("\n=== Normal ===\n")
cat("Common samples:", length(common_samples_n), "\n")

mrna_n_   <- mrna_n[common_samples_n, ]
lncrna_n_ <- lncrna_n[common_samples_n, ]
mirna_n_  <- mirna_n[common_samples_n, ]

cat("Candidate pairs:", nrow(candidate_pairs_normal), "\n")
cat("DE miRNAs:", ncol(mirna_n_), "\n")
if (nrow(candidate_pairs_normal) > 0) {
  cat("Total triplets:", format(nrow(candidate_pairs_normal) * ncol(mirna_n_), big.mark = ","), "\n")
  print(summary(candidate_pairs_normal$r))
}
```

## 5. Full Sensitivity Correlation — Tumor

```{r full-sensitivity-tumor, cache=TRUE}
library(parallel)

cat("Running tumor sensitivity correlation (", n_cores, " cores)...\n", sep = "")
full_start <- Sys.time()

sens_results_tumor <- mclapply(seq_len(nrow(candidate_pairs_tumor)), function(i) {
  lnc <- candidate_pairs_tumor$lncRNA[i]
  mrn <- candidate_pairs_tumor$mRNA[i]
  rho_xy <- candidate_pairs_tumor$r[i]
  
  x <- mrna_t_[, mrn]
  y <- lncrna_t_[, lnc]
  
  mirna_names <- colnames(mirna_t_)
  n_mirna <- length(mirna_names)
  
  S_vals       <- numeric(n_mirna)
  r_mirna_mrna <- numeric(n_mirna)
  r_mirna_lnc  <- numeric(n_mirna)
  
  for (k in seq_len(n_mirna)) {
    z <- mirna_t_[, k]
    rho_xz <- cor(x, z, use = "pairwise.complete.obs")
    rho_yz <- cor(y, z, use = "pairwise.complete.obs")
    denom <- sqrt((1 - rho_xz^2) * (1 - rho_yz^2))
    if (denom < 1e-10) {
      S_vals[k] <- NA
      r_mirna_mrna[k] <- rho_xz
      r_mirna_lnc[k]  <- rho_yz
    } else {
      rho_xy_z <- (rho_xy - rho_xz * rho_yz) / denom
      S_vals[k] <- rho_xy - rho_xy_z
      r_mirna_mrna[k] <- rho_xz
      r_mirna_lnc[k]  <- rho_yz
    }
  }
  
  data.frame(
    lncRNA       = lnc,
    mRNA         = mrn,
    miRNA        = mirna_names,
    r_lnc_mrna   = rho_xy,
    S            = S_vals,
    r_mirna_mrna = r_mirna_mrna,
    r_mirna_lnc  = r_mirna_lnc,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}, mc.cores = n_cores)

sens_df_tumor <- bind_rows(sens_results_tumor)
full_elapsed <- as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), full_start, units = "secs"))

cat("Done in", round(full_elapsed, 1), "sec\n")
cat("Total triplets:", format(nrow(sens_df_tumor), big.mark = ","), "\n")
cat("NAs:", sum(is.na(sens_df_tumor$S)), "\n")
```

## 6. Full Sensitivity Correlation — Normal

```{r full-sensitivity-normal, cache=TRUE, eval=(nrow(candidate_pairs_normal) > 0)}

  r_mirna_lnc  <- numeric(n_mirna)
  
  for (k in seq_len(n_mirna)) {
    z <- mirna_n_[, k]
    rho_xz <- cor(x, z, use = "pairwise.complete.obs")
    rho_yz <- cor(y, z, use = "pairwise.complete.obs")
    denom <- sqrt((1 - rho_xz^2) * (1 - rho_yz^2))
    if (denom < 1e-10) {
      S_vals[k] <- NA
      r_mirna_mrna[k] <- rho_xz
      r_mirna_lnc[k]  <- rho_yz
    } else {
      rho_xy_z <- (rho_xy - rho_xz * rho_yz) / denom
      S_vals[k] <- rho_xy - rho_xy_z
      r_mirna_mrna[k] <- rho_xz
      r_mirna_lnc[k]  <- rho_yz
    }
  }
  
  data.frame(
    lncRNA       = lnc,
    mRNA         = mrn,
    miRNA        = mirna_names,
    r_lnc_mrna   = rho_xy,
    S            = S_vals,
    r_mirna_mrna = r_mirna_mrna,

sens_df_normal <- bind_rows(sens_results_normal)
```

## 7. S Distribution & Threshold Selection

```{r s-distributions, fig.width=12, fig.height=5}
# Tumor
S_clean <- sens_df_tumor$S[!is.na(sens_df_tumor$S)]
p99 <- round(quantile(S_clean, 0.99), 1)

cat("=== Tumor S distribution ===\n")
cat("Min:", round(min(S_clean), 2), "\n")
cat("Median:", round(median(S_clean), 2), "\n")
cat("Mean:", round(mean(S_clean), 2), "\n")
cat("99th pctl:", p99, "\n")
cat("Max:", round(max(S_clean), 2), "\n")

p_s_tumor <- ggplot(data.frame(S = S_clean), aes(x = S)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 150, fill = "steelblue", color = NA, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = p99, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  annotate("text", x = p99 + 0.005, y = Inf, vjust = 2,
           label = paste0("99th = ", p99), color = "red", size = 3.5) +
  labs(title = "Tumor: Sensitivity Correlation Distribution",
       x = "S", y = "Count") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12)

# Normal
if (exists("sens_df_normal") && nrow(sens_df_normal) > 0) {
  S_clean_n <- sens_df_normal$S[!is.na(sens_df_normal$S)]
  p99_n <- round(quantile(S_clean_n, 0.99), 1)
  
  cat("\n=== Normal S distribution ===\n")
  cat("Min:", round(min(S_clean_n), 2), "\n")
  cat("Median:", round(median(S_clean_n), 2), "\n")
  cat("Mean:", round(mean(S_clean_n), 2), "\n")
  cat("99th pctl:", p99_n, "\n")
  cat("Max:", round(max(S_clean_n), 2), "\n")
  
  p_s_normal <- ggplot(data.frame(S = S_clean_n), aes(x = S)) +
    geom_histogram(bins = 150, fill = "#377EB8", color = NA, alpha = 0.7) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = p99_n, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
    annotate("text", x = p99_n + 0.01, y = Inf, vjust = 2,
             label = paste0("99th = ", p99_n), color = "red", size = 3.5) +
    labs(title = "Normal: Sensitivity Correlation Distribution",
         x = "S", y = "Count") +
    theme_classic(base_size = 12)
  
  p_s_tumor + p_s_normal + plot_annotation(tag_levels = "A")
} else {
  p_s_tumor
}
```

## 8. Filter ceRNA Triplets

```{r filter-tumor}
S_threshold <- p99
cat("=== TUMOR ===\n")
cat("S threshold:", S_threshold, "(99th percentile)\n\n")

cerna_triplets_tumor <- sens_df_tumor %>%
  filter(!is.na(S), S > S_threshold, r_mirna_mrna < 0, r_mirna_lnc < 0) %>%
  arrange(desc(S))

cat("Passing S threshold only:", sum(sens_df_tumor$S > S_threshold, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
cat("Passing S + negative cors:", nrow(cerna_triplets_tumor), "\n")
cat("Unique lncRNAs:", n_distinct(cerna_triplets_tumor$lncRNA), "\n")
cat("Unique mRNAs:", n_distinct(cerna_triplets_tumor$mRNA), "\n")
cat("Unique miRNAs:", n_distinct(cerna_triplets_tumor$miRNA), "\n")
cat("\n=== Top 20 triplets ===\n")
print(head(cerna_triplets_tumor, 20))
```

```{r filter-normal, eval=(exists("sens_df_normal") && nrow(sens_df_normal) > 0)}
S_threshold_n <- p99_n
cat("=== NORMAL ===\n")
cat("S threshold:", S_threshold_n, "(99th percentile)\n\n")

cerna_triplets_normal <- sens_df_normal %>%
  filter(!is.na(S), S > S_threshold_n, r_mirna_mrna < 0, r_mirna_lnc < 0) %>%
  arrange(desc(S))

cat("Passing S threshold only:", sum(sens_df_normal$S > S_threshold_n, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
cat("Passing S + negative cors:", nrow(cerna_triplets_normal), "\n")
cat("Unique lncRNAs:", n_distinct(cerna_triplets_normal$lncRNA), "\n")
cat("Unique mRNAs:", n_distinct(cerna_triplets_normal$mRNA), "\n")
cat("Unique miRNAs:", n_distinct(cerna_triplets_normal$miRNA), "\n")

if (nrow(cerna_triplets_normal) > 0) {
  cat("\n=== Top 20 triplets ===\n")
  print(head(cerna_triplets_normal, 20))
}
```

## 9. Hub Analysis

```{r tumor-hubs}
lnc_hubs <- cerna_triplets_tumor %>%
  group_by(lncRNA) %>%
  summarise(
    n_mRNAs = n_distinct(mRNA), n_miRNAs = n_distinct(miRNA),
    n_edges = n(), mean_S = mean(S), .groups = "drop"
  ) %>% arrange(desc(n_edges))

mirna_hubs <- cerna_triplets_tumor %>%
  group_by(miRNA) %>%
  summarise(
    n_lncRNAs = n_distinct(lncRNA), n_mRNAs = n_distinct(mRNA),
    n_edges = n(), .groups = "drop"
  ) %>% arrange(desc(n_edges))

cat("=== Tumor hub lncRNAs ===\n")
print(lnc_hubs)
cat("\n=== Tumor hub miRNAs ===\n")
print(mirna_hubs)
```

```{r normal-hubs, eval=(exists("cerna_triplets_normal") && nrow(cerna_triplets_normal) > 0)}
lnc_hubs_n <- cerna_triplets_normal %>%
  group_by(lncRNA) %>%
  summarise(
    n_mRNAs = n_distinct(mRNA), n_miRNAs = n_distinct(miRNA),
    n_edges = n(), mean_S = mean(S), .groups = "drop"
  ) %>% arrange(desc(n_edges))

mirna_hubs_n <- cerna_triplets_normal %>%
  group_by(miRNA) %>%
  summarise(
    n_lncRNAs = n_distinct(lncRNA), n_mRNAs = n_distinct(mRNA),
    n_edges = n(), .groups = "drop"
  ) %>% arrange(desc(n_edges))

cat("=== Normal hub lncRNAs ===\n")
print(lnc_hubs_n)
cat("\n=== Normal hub miRNAs ===\n")
print(mirna_hubs_n)
```

## 10. Tumor vs Normal Comparison

```{r compare-networks}
cat("=== Network Comparison ===\n")
cat("\nTumor network:\n")
cat("  Correlation threshold (99th pctl):", threshold_tumor, "\n")
cat("  S threshold (99th pctl):", S_threshold, "\n")
cat("  Triplets:", nrow(cerna_triplets_tumor), "\n")
cat("  lncRNAs:", n_distinct(cerna_triplets_tumor$lncRNA), "\n")
cat("  mRNAs:", n_distinct(cerna_triplets_tumor$mRNA), "\n")
cat("  miRNAs:", n_distinct(cerna_triplets_tumor$miRNA), "\n")

if (!exists("cerna_triplets_normal")) {
  cerna_triplets_normal <- data.frame()
}

cat("\nNormal network:\n")
cat("  Correlation threshold (99th pctl):", threshold_normal, "\n")
if (nrow(cerna_triplets_normal) > 0) {
  cat("  S threshold (99th pctl):", S_threshold_n, "\n")
  cat("  Triplets:", nrow(cerna_triplets_normal), "\n")
  cat("  lncRNAs:", n_distinct(cerna_triplets_normal$lncRNA), "\n")
  cat("  mRNAs:", n_distinct(cerna_triplets_normal$mRNA), "\n")
  cat("  miRNAs:", n_distinct(cerna_triplets_normal$miRNA), "\n")
  
  shared_lnc  <- intersect(cerna_triplets_tumor$lncRNA, cerna_triplets_normal$lncRNA)
  shared_mrna <- intersect(cerna_triplets_tumor$mRNA, cerna_triplets_normal$mRNA)
  shared_mirna <- intersect(cerna_triplets_tumor$miRNA, cerna_triplets_normal$miRNA)
  
  cat("\nShared lncRNAs:", length(shared_lnc), "\n")
  if (length(shared_lnc) > 0) cat("  ", paste(shared_lnc, collapse = ", "), "\n")
  cat("Shared mRNAs:", length(shared_mrna), "\n")
  if (length(shared_mrna) > 0) cat("  ", paste(shared_mrna, collapse = ", "), "\n")
  cat("Shared miRNAs:", length(shared_mirna), "\n")
  if (length(shared_mirna) > 0) cat("  ", paste(shared_mirna, collapse = ", "), "\n")
} else {
  cat("  No triplets — normal ceRNA network is empty.\n")
}
```

## 11. Save Everything

```{r save-all}
save(sens_df_tumor, cerna_triplets_tumor, S_threshold, lnc_hubs, mirna_hubs,
     threshold_tumor, threshold_normal,
     sens_df_normal, cerna_triplets_normal, S_threshold_n, lnc_hubs_n, mirna_hubs_n,
     file = file.path(results_dir, "sensitivity_results.RData"))

# Tumor edges
cyto_edges <- bind_rows(
  cerna_triplets_tumor %>%
    distinct(lncRNA, miRNA) %>%
    transmute(source = lncRNA, target = miRNA, interaction = "sponge"),
  cerna_triplets_tumor %>%
    distinct(miRNA, mRNA) %>%
    transmute(source = miRNA, target = mRNA, interaction = "repression")
)
write_csv(cyto_edges, file.path(results_dir, "cerna_network_edges.csv"))
cat("Saved", nrow(cyto_edges), "tumor edges for Cytoscape\n")

# Tumor node types
node_types <- bind_rows(
  cerna_triplets_tumor %>% distinct(node = lncRNA) %>% mutate(type = "lncRNA"),
  cerna_triplets_tumor %>% distinct(node = miRNA) %>% mutate(type = "miRNA"),
  cerna_triplets_tumor %>% distinct(node = mRNA) %>% mutate(type = "mRNA")
)
write_csv(node_types, file.path(results_dir, "cerna_network_nodes.csv"))
cat("Saved", nrow(node_types), "tumor node types\n")

# Normal edges + nodes
if (nrow(cerna_triplets_normal) > 0) {
  cyto_edges_n <- bind_rows(
    cerna_triplets_normal %>%
      distinct(lncRNA, miRNA) %>%
      transmute(source = lncRNA, target = miRNA, interaction = "sponge"),
    cerna_triplets_normal %>%
      distinct(miRNA, mRNA) %>%
      transmute(source = miRNA, target = mRNA, interaction = "repression")
  )
  write_csv(cyto_edges_n, file.path(results_dir, "cerna_network_edges_normal.csv"))
  cat("Saved", nrow(cyto_edges_n), "normal edges for Cytoscape\n")
  
  node_types_n <- bind_rows(
    cerna_triplets_normal %>% distinct(node = lncRNA) %>% mutate(type = "lncRNA"),
    cerna_triplets_normal %>% distinct(node = miRNA) %>% mutate(type = "miRNA"),
    cerna_triplets_normal %>% distinct(node = mRNA) %>% mutate(type = "mRNA")
  )
  write_csv(node_types_n, file.path(results_dir, "cerna_network_nodes_normal.csv"))
  cat("Saved", nrow(node_types_n), "normal node types\n")
}

cat("\nAll results saved.\n")
```
